limits: This is a rules accuracy/completeness audit within the specified base scope, not a claim to reproduce every Law paragraph, glossary entry, or FAQ illustration verbatim.

Faction-board track costs, victory-point values, draw-bonus positions and relationship thresholds are delegated to the actual faction board in the candidate; those boards/cards are not separate allowed inputs. No numeric track table is invented.
Publisher rendered text drops custom item icons; direct PDF text and seven rendered physical-page views resolve those glyphs.

Publisher p16 omits a standalone 1.3.3 consent rule in its rendered text, but the October 2025 PDF includes it and the publisher FAQs affirm it. PDF governs declared edition; no relevant conflict found.

Play-time estimate, BGG identifier, source URL provenance, historical verification wording and administrative dates are not independently proved by the permitted rule sources. Designer credit is supported on PDF physical30. These non-rules metadata limits do not change the base-rules verdict.
No browsing or inspection of external card library, faction boards, previous QA artifacts, reader materials, keys, questions, prior conclusions, or repair history was performed.
Initial combined summary output was visibly truncated; it was replaced by two complete bounded summary outputs and a complete metadata output. Final coverage relies only on those complete deliveries.
